In Sarasota, 18 studios compete for dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 18 dance and ballroom studios serving the Sarasota market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 52 to 91. The AI engines name only nine of the 18. The field averages 66 (D) on AI readiness, 18 of 18 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 9 of 18 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 29 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Sarasota, FL area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 18 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • SRQ Dance Instructor (91) and That's Dancing (Dance Alliance of Bradenton) (91) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 52. Four scores are shared.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 66 (D) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 85.
  • None of the 18 studios has FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 9 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. No studio in the market has both.
  • Four of the 18 are franchise locations (two Arthur Murray and two Fred Astaire); the rest are independent studios.
  • The gap between #1 and #18 is 39 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

For a studio not doing this work, that's the default outcome — not a penalty, just the result of nobody in that seat having claimed it yet.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in Sarasota.” Studios that serve Sarasota from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

Methodology & notes

Field (18 studios): srqdanceinstructors.com, danceallianceofbradenton.com, dancingonthesuncoast.com, arthurmurraysarasotafl.com, dynastydanceclubs.com, fredastaire.com/sarasota, fredastaire.com/lakewood-ranch, arthurmurraylwr.com, bachatafuego.com, sarabaydanceclub.com, evoballroomstudio.com, saradancecenter.com, theballroomofsarasota.com, stepupdancestudiosrq.com, dkdancecreations.com, thedanceroomsrq.com, westiesrq.com, aclassballroom.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 29 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Sarasota dance searches. Sarasota and Bradenton are one page. Arthur Murray has two Sarasota listings (South Tamiami and Downtown) on one website; they're counted as one studio, at the best position either reached. Left out: Wilson's Dance Club International in Bradenton (its website returns an error), Vision of Dance (its website is down), Ballroom City (its domain no longer resolves), SouL Dance Studio (no studio address on Google), and the youth, ballet and recital studios that lead the broad answers (The Dance Haus SRQ, Energize Dance Studio, Stage Door Studios, Sarasota Contemporary Dance, Bradenton Dance Center).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 29 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories. Franchise locations that live on a national website (Fred Astaire) share that site's robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap and templates.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Sarasota, FL?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Sarasota, FL?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's web app (ChatGPT and Gemini logged out, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 29 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons sarasota fl”; “dance lessons sarasota fl”; “salsa lessons sarasota fl”; “wedding dance lessons sarasota fl”; “ballroom dance lessons bradenton fl”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in sarasota fl” and “ballroom dance studio sarasota”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
